differences.a_observable: Camera slowly pans and rotates, shifting perspective on the cards.
differences.b_observable: Camera remains completely static after the cut.
differences.fix: Animate the camera to match the reference's slow pan and rotation.

differences.a_observable: Cards are staggered diagonally with a distinct perspective tilt.
differences.b_observable: Cards are aligned in a straight vertical column with flat perspective.
differences.fix: Stagger the cards diagonally and adjust the camera angle for more perspective tilt.

differences.a_observable: Deep contact shadows under the cards create a strong sense of depth.
differences.b_observable: Faint contact shadows make the cards appear flat against the background.
differences.fix: Increase the intensity of contact shadows and ambient occlusion.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette with darker corners and soft light falloff.
differences.b_observable: Flat, even lighting across the frame with no visible vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette in post-production to match the reference.

json.highest_impact_fix: Animate the camera after the cut to match the slow pan and rotation of the reference, and stagger the cards diagonally to restore the dynamic layout.
